predicate.label: research fellow at institution
predicate.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified research, academic, or policy fellowship at institution Y.
includes: explicit fellow-at/for/of or institutional fellow title
excludes: scholar, professor, economist, analyst or ordinary membership without a fellow title
a colleague described merely as fellow person
ambiguous: unclear fellowship title or institutional attachment
honorific membership versus a research fellowship when unresolved
predicate.notes: This is a specific fellowship role; nearby scholar or economist roles may coexist but do not establish it alone.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit fellow-at/for/of or institutional fellow title; historical fellowship. Excludes: scholar, professor, economist, analyst or ordinary membership without a fellow title; a colleague described merely as fellow person; institutional employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear fellowship title or institutional attachment; honorific membership versus a research fellowship when unresolved. This is a specific fellowship role; nearby scholar or economist roles may coexist but do not establish it alone.

rationale: Three explicit institutional fellow title paths form the coherent specific primary role, distinct from scholar status alone and political commentary. Independently reviewed by Boyle.
